jobs.description:
Bedrijfsomschrijving 
This company (re)packages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. They do this in a customized way for each client. By 2027, the company aims to have more than 300 employees working together on 25,000 unique packaging assignments.

Working at this company means working in a respectful environment where strong connection between employees and dedication to the work go hand in hand.

You are a key point of contact on the work floor and maintain an overview of the day-to-day logistics operations. At the same time, you take an active, hands-on role in the work yourself.

 
• 
You operate a forklift, reach truck and pallet truck and assist wherever needed.

 
• 
You maintain an overview of the logistics operations and organise the work to ensure everything runs smoothly.

 
• 
You guide and supervise colleagues in a clear and positive manner.

 
• 
You monitor safety, quality and the correct execution of all activities.

 
• 
You accurately scan labels and storage locations and ensure that all movements of goods are correctly registered.

 
• 
When deviations or unexpected situations occur, you respond quickly and take a practical approach to finding solutions.

 
• 
As a key point of contact on the work floor, you contribute to effective teamwork and cooperation.

 
• 
You help ensure that logistics operations are carried out efficiently and in an organised manner.

Ready to take responsibility, support your team and get the job done? You can read below what we are looking for.

 
• 
You have experience in a logistics or warehouse environment and are familiar with day-to-day warehouse operations.

 
• 
You have experience supervising, guiding or coordinating employees.

 
• 
Working hands-on alongside the team is an important part of this position and is something you are comfortable with.

 
• 
You have practical experience operating a forklift and/or reach truck and hold the required certificates.

 
• 
Experience with a pallet truck is an advantage, but not a requirement.

 
• 
You are able to maintain an overview, set priorities and adapt quickly when schedules or circumstances change.

 
• 
You communicate clearly with colleagues and are able to guide employees in a positive manner.

 
• 
You actively monitor safety and quality on the work floor.

 
• 
You communicate well in Dutch and English and have a basic knowledge of French. This is important because you will be supervising logistics employees who speak Dutch, English or French.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
This company repackages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. These services are tailored to the specific needs of each customer. By 2025, the company aims to employ more than 300 people, who together handle 25,000 unique packaging orders. Working for this company means being part of a respectful environment where strong teamwork and dedication to the job go hand in hand.

You are the day-to-day point of contact on the production floor, making sure the team knows what needs to be done. You keep a close eye on both the employees and the production process.

Your main responsibilities will include:

 
• 
You lead and coach a team of approximately 15 employees within the manual packaging department.

 
• 
You organise the daily activities and ensure that operations run smoothly and efficiently.

 
• 
During production, you monitor quality, food safety and hygiene.

 
• 
You keep track of production planning and staffing levels and make adjustments when necessary.

 
• 
You identify operational bottlenecks and look for ways to improve efficiency and productivity.

 
• 
You motivate employees, provide feedback and address issues when necessary.

 
• 
You contribute to strong teamwork and a positive working atmosphere.

 
• 
You support new colleagues during their onboarding and training.

 
• 
You work closely with other departments and report on daily operations.

 
• 
When the situation requires it, you are happy to roll up your sleeves and work alongside the team on the production floor.

You keep a cool head when plans change and understand what your team needs to keep moving forward. You are visible and approachable on the production floor, provide clear direction and make adjustments where necessary. Sound like you? Then this could be your dream job!

 
• 
You have experience in the food industry, preferably within a production or packaging environment.

 
• 
Previous experience in a supervisory or team-leading role is a strong advantage.

 
• 
You know how to motivate and coach employees and provide clear, constructive feedback.

 
• 
You communicate clearly, respectfully and assertively.

 
• 
When organising the work, you take both quality and efficiency into account.

 
• 
You are able to set priorities and organise daily activities effectively.

 
• 
You take responsibility and show initiative.

 
• 
Changing circumstances sometimes require quick adjustments, and you are able to respond accordingly.

 
• 
You enjoy being present on the production floor and are willing to work alongside the team when needed.

 
• 
You work daytime hours, but are flexible when necessary.

 
• 
You have a good language of Dutch and English, allowing you to communicate effectively with colleagues and supervisors.

We're looking for a Logistics Coordinator. 

In this role you will be responsible for handling laboratory supplies, study materials, medical devices and drug products, used in clinical trials.

Tasks:

• Manage returned materials and maintain inventory records from clinical sites
• Coordinate logistics activities for clinical studies
• Support purchasing activities when required
• Ensure compliance with company procedures and regulatory requirements
• Support the daily operations of the Central Laboratory supply team

A strong knowledge (written and spoken) in English is required, knowledge in another language is a big asset. Logistics tasks such as shipping, calling, mailing, checking in on stock, are interesting to you. A detail and client oriented mentality is needed. You ensure a day to day fluency in logistics and supply chain.

At Agristo, you are the key player in the packaging process: from frozen fries to a perfectly packaged and palletized product. With your technical affinity and problem-solving abilities, you manage our packaging lines, coordinate the planning, and ensure a flawless process. Are you looking for a challenging role with responsibility, teamwork, and growth opportunities in a dynamic work environment? Join us and grow with a strong, ambitious family business!What will you be doing at Agristo? 
• Process Management: You are responsible for the entire packaging process, from frozen fries to a fully palletized and packaged product. 
• Operation and Adjustment: You provide first-line support for any issues on the line, make adjustments when necessary, and continuously expand your technical knowledge of our processes. 
• Planning & Coordination: You monitor and adjust the packaging schedule, coordinating its execution with the team leader to meet the planned goals. 
• Cleanliness and Hygiene: You ensure a clean and organized work environment by overseeing and coordinating cleaning tasks. 
• Material Management: You are responsible for the timely ordering and availability of necessary materials, such as film, cardboard, and spices. 
• Problem Solving: You proactively identify issues in the packaging process and take corrective actions to ensure continuity. 
• Administrative Support: You perform administrative tasks, such as reporting incidents and documenting process information. 
• Packaging Testing: You assist in and conduct packaging process tests in collaboration with Agristo colleagues. 
• Knowledge Sharing: You contribute to the development of instructions and training materials and support knowledge transfer within the team. 
• Employee Guidance: You mentor and support team members, helping them enhance their skills and knowledge.With this diverse range of responsibilities, you are an essential link in ensuring a smooth and high-quality packaging process!
 
• You have solid experience as a packaging operator in the food industry or have already gained experience in a coordinating role. 
• You possess technical and process insight. 
• You have a problem-solving mindset, are not afraid to critically assess existing processes, and take initiative to implement improvements. 
• You speak Dutch, French, or English and are willing to communicate with colleagues who speak different languages.

jobs.occupation: AI Security Engineer – LLM & GenAI Security

jobs.occupation: Extrusion Operator – 2 Shifts & Permanent Night Shift
jobs.description:
For a company in regio Wielsbeke we are looking for motivated and technically skilled Extrusion Operators to join the production team. We have opportunities available in both a two-shift system (early and late shifts) and a permanent night shift.

As an Extrusion Operator, you will be responsible for operating and monitoring extrusion machinery to ensure efficient production and consistent product quality.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Operate and monitor extrusion machines and production lines.

• Set up machines and adjust process parameters according to production requirements.

• Monitor product quality and ensure compliance with quality standards.

• Perform routine quality checks and make adjustments when necessary.

• Identify and report machine malfunctions or production issues.

• Carry out basic cleaning and maintenance tasks.

• Follow all health, safety, and production procedures.

• Work closely with colleagues and supervisors to achieve production targets.

 

Your Profile:

• Experience in extrusion or a similar production environment is an advantage.

• Technical understanding and a hands-on approach.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

• Flexible and willing to work either a two-shift system or a permanent night shift.

• Reliable, motivated, and eager to learn.

• You speak English or Dutch fluently.

As an Operator in Hot Kitchen Department, you are responsible for independently operating various production machines. In this department, ingredients and prepared products are fried, cooked, steamed, mixed, and boiled.

Your responsibilities include operating equipment such as cooking kettles, filling machines, mixers, and combi steam ovens. You also prepare dishes and food components in accordance with our quality, hygiene, and safety standards.

 

What does the job involve?

As a Kitchen Operator, you are the right-hand person of the Team Leader in the Hot Kitchen Department, supporting them in the production of prepared dishes and food components.

You are responsible for preparing and carrying out recipes. Your tasks include:

• Taking over the duties of kitchen staff in their absence.

• Carrying out the necessary quality checks on raw materials and preparing them for processing when required. Depending on the workload, you work together with kitchen staff, providing them with clear instructions and guidance to ensure that their tasks are carried out correctly.

• Independently following and executing recipes in accordance with quality standards and IFS requirements.

• Ensuring that industrial equipment is properly cleaned after and between each production run, in accordance with hygiene regulations.

• Preparing spice blends according to the recipes when the Goods Receiving employee is absent.

• Correctly preparing frozen ingredients and recipe components according to the production order.

• Labelling semi-finished products and recording their use in our computer system.

• Recording cooling temperatures.

Requirements:

• You have a very good command of Dutch (speaking, reading, writing, and understanding). A good knowledge of English and/or French is an advantage.

• You are comfortable with basic calculations, reading weights, and using weighing scales.

• You have completed training in a culinary field (institutional catering, chef, catering assistant, or butcher) or have equivalent experience.

• You are familiar with food safety regulations.

• You are able to operate a manual pallet truck.

• You are flexible and enjoy the challenge of switching between different departments.

• You can work well under pressure. Things can get quite busy at Marblo! 

• You maintain a neat and well-groomed appearance. For hygiene and safety reasons, gel nails, excessive make-up, visible piercings, etc., are not permitted in our production areas.
